methods.description: Starts or stops conversation mode, in which the pill listens, sends each spoken turn to one pane and speaks the reply. A start turns on voice mode of the target pane, and a stop puts it back as it was. While the mode runs, voice.transcript submits the text to the target pane. A compositor bind runs it with agentsi-core converse toggle. The core sends converse.state. It answers unavailable when no pill is subscribed to the dictation topic or a dictation runs, and invalid when a start has no target pane.
